svg.title: Three collections: Person with the documents Mary and John, Book with the document Arango, and Author with the document Sara
svg.desc: Collections are drawn as folders and documents as pages. The Person collection holds two documents, Mary aged 34 and John aged 31. The Book collection holds one document with the title Arango and 320 pages. The Author collection holds one document with the name Sara and the country DE.
